- [RARC.9.5.2] **Adapter availability.** When the
  integrator's call callback handles an adapter that
  is currently unreachable, it returns `CallError`
  with an `adapter.*` code whose leaf it chooses ([LECC.4.3]) —
  reachability is the integrator's environment and DS
  specifies no leaf for it ([LCRS.10.6.1]). The rule sees
  that `CallError` as it sees any ([LCRS.4.2.1]).
